notes: Verified via Wayback Machine snapshot of msme.gov.in. 66 pages, 4.0 MB, 14 PMEGP mentions. This is the official MSME Schemes Booklet for FY 2022-23, with PMEGP as scheme #1 (pages 3-12). Includes PMEGP eligibility, subsidy rates, application procedure, EDP training, and the 2nd loan upgradation scheme. Also covers other MSME schemes (CGTMSE, PMEGP e-portal, etc.). Broader than PMEGP-only but PMEGP is the lead scheme. Date set to 2022-04-01 (start of FY 2022-23) as the booklet is labeled '2022-23'.
